stories.title: Funded childcare applications for Flintshire two-year-olds open on 1 September
stories.summary: Parents in Flintshire can apply for funded childcare for two-year-olds from 1 September, with places available from 2 November. Flintshire County Council said the funded places will be available across the county. stories.title: Hawarden Gladstone’s Library roof restoration enters final weeks as scaffolding removed
stories.summary: Scaffolding is being taken down at Gladstone’s Library in Hawarden after the first major repairs to the roof of the Grade I listed building. stories.title: Low pressure and no water in parts of Deeside after overnight burst main
stories.summary: Some homes in Shotton, Queensferry and Sandycroft have been left with low pressure or no water after a burst main on the Welsh Water network.
